title: Countable Tracker — Atin view
blurb: Monthly is source of truth. Click an Actual to open the deals behind the number. Watch Aug–Nov (~130 firms / BDR ~65 volume).

kpis.label: Qualified Leads Generated
kpis.notes: Contacts who submitted a demand-generation form in the period, dated by HubSpot's first_conversion_date.

kpis.label: Marketing-Sourced Meetings Booked
kpis.notes: Deals from a marketing lead source (form, event, social) that reached a held meeting.

kpis.label: Pipeline Contribution %
kpis.notes: Marketing-sourced ACV on deals still in an active Sales stage ÷ all active-stage ACV created in the period (Closed Lost and 12-Month Follow-Up excluded).

kpis.label: Meetings Booked — Team (2 SDRs)
kpis.notes: SDR Meeting Log rows by Date Booked in the period.

kpis.label: Meetings on Calendar
kpis.notes: Meeting Log rows whose Meeting Date falls in the period.

kpis.label: Meetings Booked — Surbhi
kpis.notes: Meeting Log rows booked by Surbhi in the period.

kpis.label: Meetings Booked — Merry
kpis.notes: Meeting Log rows booked by Merry in the period.

kpis.label: Free Trials Started
kpis.notes: Deals whose free-trial start date falls in the period.

kpis.label: Direct / Organic Free Trials Started
kpis.notes: Trials that started without a meeting-held path — marketing signup, referral, or direct_free_trial deal_source.

kpis.label: Active Trials in Pipeline
kpis.notes: Deals sitting in a trial stage at the period's end, rebuilt from stage history.

kpis.label: Meeting → Trial Conversion %
kpis.notes: Held-meeting deals that started a trial within 45 days ÷ held meetings, excluding marketing / referral / direct-trial sources.

kpis.label: Active Pipeline → New Meetings Booked %
kpis.notes: Deals that entered Meeting Booked in the period ÷ open deals in New or Establishing Contact at the period's start.

kpis.label: Weighted Pipeline Value (Probability-Adjusted, $)
kpis.notes: Deal amount — HubSpot's own stage win probability, summed across open sales-pipeline deals.

kpis.label: Paid Firms Closed — Team
kpis.notes: Closed-won deals in the period, test records excluded.

kpis.label: Unique Firms Closed Won (Firm-ID Deduped)
kpis.notes: Closed-won customer deals grouped by firm identity, so one firm under two names counts once.

kpis.label: Paid Firms Closed — Chinmay
kpis.notes: Closed-won deals in the period, owned by Chinmay.

kpis.label: Paid Firms Closed — Vaibhav
kpis.notes: Closed-won deals in the period, owned by Vaibhav.

kpis.label: Revenue Closed (New ACV, $)
kpis.notes: Annual contract value of closed-won deals, in CAD.

kpis.label: Average Deal Size (ACV, $)
kpis.notes: Won revenue ÷ won deals with a resolvable value.

kpis.label: Win Rate (BDR-Sourced)
kpis.notes: Won deals ÷ won plus lost deals in the period.

kpis.label: Average Sales Cycle (Days)
kpis.notes: Mean days from create to close on won deals.

kpis.label: Paid Clients — Average users per firm
kpis.notes: Mean seat count across customer deals active at the period's end.

kpis.label: Paid Clients — Users
kpis.notes: Total seats across customer deals active at the period's end.

kpis.label: Trial → Paid Conversion Rate
kpis.notes: Won deals that came from a trial ÷ trials started, on the 2026 cohort, lagged.

kpis.label: Training Completion Rate (%)
kpis.notes: Training done ÷ training done plus no-training minus lost, from the CS Monthly KPI tracker.

kpis.label: Flex — Committed (#)
kpis.notes: Firms marked Hot priority in Falah's Flex Plan sheet — proxy for Committed when that Status column is empty.

kpis.label: Flex — In Conversation (#)
kpis.notes: Firms marked Warm priority in the same sheet — proxy for In Conversation.

kpis.label: Flex — Paid-Activated (#)
kpis.notes: Firms marked Under an Active Plan in the Flex Plan sheet — the Flex equivalent of a won count.

kpis.label: Free Trial Expired Rate (%)
kpis.notes: Trials whose expiry falls in/before the period end and are expired ÷ trials with an expiry date on or before period end.
